name: Think it through
description: Draft an answer, critique it, and let me decide whether to revise or accept.

draft.title: Draft
draft.instructions: Write a thorough first draft answering the prompt. When the draft is complete, call the transition tool.

critique.title: Critique
critique.instructions: You are a demanding reviewer. Critique the draft from the previous stage: what is wrong, missing, or weak. Then write an improved version. When done, call the transition tool.

decide.title: Decide
decide.instructions: Accept the improved version, or send it back for another critique pass.
